parts.text:
On Fig. 1.1, use label lines and letters to show:
**A** - a cell in the epidermal layer
**B** - a cell that contains PEP carboxylase.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Identify the cell type labelled **C** in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how the leaf anatomy shown in Fig. 1.1 adapts the $\text{C}_4$ plant to maintain a high rate of photosynthesis at high temperatures.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Fig. 1.2 shows the results of an experiment comparing the rate of carbon dioxide uptake in a $\text{C}_3$ plant (*Chenopodium album*) and a $\text{C}_4$ plant (*Amaranthus retroflexus*) in high and low carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) conditions.
The rate of $\text{CO}_2$ uptake is used to measure the rate of photosynthesis.
{{figure:figure_1_2.png}}
Fig. 1.2
parts.text: Using Fig. 1.2, compare the rates of photosynthesis in **high** $\text{CO}_2$ conditions in the $\text{C}_3$ and $\text{C}_4$ plants.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Using Fig. 1.2, compare the rates of photosynthesis in low and high $\text{CO}_2$ conditions in the $\text{C}_4$ plant between $30^\circ\text{C}$ and $35^\circ\text{C}$ **and** suggest an explanation for this difference.
